app.title: Browser automation
app.subtitle: AUTOMATION PORTAL
app.footer_note: M3 management portal · local use only
scenes.description: Manage scenario revisions, inputs and outputs under stable IDs. Only a revision that passed validation can be published and run.
scenes.empty: No scenarios yet. Create one, or import the examples from scenarios/demo.
scenes.new_notice: Creating a scenario makes a v1 draft with a single step that opens a page. Change it into the real steps on the edit page.
scenes.new_id: Scenario ID (lowercase letters, digits, - or _; it cannot be changed or reused)
revision.id_mismatch: The id in the scenario file must be {id} (scenario IDs cannot change)
revision.extra_file: {path} is not used by this scenario
revision.no_scenario: The scenario file scenario.yaml is missing
scene.not_published: Nothing is published yet: validate a revision, publish it once it passes, then run it.
scene.newer_draft: Runs use the published v{published}; v{latest} is used only after it passes validation and is published.
scene.versions_hint: Revisions are immutable; editing creates a new revision
scene.base_url_hint: Prefilled when validating and running. Leave empty to use the baseUrl in the scenario file ({default}).
spec.name: Name
edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.older: This is the older v{shown}. Saving creates a new revision with this content (the latest is v{latest}).
edit.notice: The files are validated before saving; nothing is saved if there are problems. A new revision must pass validation before it can be published.
edit.note_placeholder: For example: use the new submit button
run_form.description_validation: Runs v{number} in a real browser; once it passes, this revision can be published.
run_form.notice_validation: Validation really operates the target site, including steps with side effects such as creating records. Use a test environment or test data.
run_form.notice_execution: Operates the target site with the published revision. Steps with side effects are never retried automatically.
run_form.inputs_hint: Defaults are filled in; inputs without a default must be filled in. They are checked first, and the browser is not started if any input is invalid.
run_form.base_url_hint: Overrides the baseUrl in the scenario file. Leave empty to use the scenario file.
runs.description: Filter by category, scenario and result. Every run keeps its inputs, outputs, steps, assertions and screenshots.
runs.multi_hint: Multiple selection: hold Ctrl on Windows or ⌘ on macOS. Nothing selected means all.
run.title: Run {id}
run.polling: Running; this page updates when the status changes.
run.newer_validation: The latest validation of this revision did not pass, so this result cannot be used to publish it. Validate it again.
run.interrupted: The server restarted and interrupted this run; run it again
run.hash_mismatch: The content that ran does not match the revision hash, so this validation does not count
run.scenario_invalid: The scenario file has {count} problem(s) and cannot run
run.crashed: The run failed with an error: {detail}
error.revision_unreadable: The files of scenario {id} v{number} are missing or no longer valid
error.scene_id_invalid: Invalid scenario ID "{id}": start with a lowercase letter or digit and use only lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (at most 64)
error.revision_invalid: {count} problem(s) found; no revision was created
error.scene_exists: The scenario ID {id} is already used (including archived scenarios); choose another
error.revision_conflict: Someone just saved a new revision of {id}; reload and edit again
error.stale_base: You started from v{base}, but the latest is now v{latest}. Reload and edit the latest revision
error.no_examples: The examples folder was not found (RPA_EXAMPLES_DIR)
error.inputs_invalid: {count} input problem(s); the run was not started
error.not_validated: Scenario {id} v{number} has not passed validation and cannot be published
error.content_changed: The files of scenario {id} v{number} differ from what was validated; it cannot be published
error.file_not_found: {path} is not in the run folder
error.base_url_invalid: The URL must start with http or https: {value}
error_page.title: Something went wrong
placeholder.recording_description: Record actions → DSL draft → debug in an isolated browser → validate → publish by hand.
placeholder.recording_plan: In M4 this page records browser actions, turns them into scenario drafts, and handles sign-in and roles. Drafts still go through validation and manual publishing; a recording never becomes a published revision by itself.
placeholder.playground_description: Chain published scenarios so that each one's outputs become the next one's inputs.
placeholder.playground_plan: In M6 this page arranges scenario sequences with pinned revisions, output bindings and stop-on-failure. Until then, copy the outputs of one run into the inputs of the next scenario by hand.
server.sqlite_notice: Using SQLite: for development and prototypes only. Set RPA_DATABASE_URL to PostgreSQL in production
server.recovered: {count} run(s) were interrupted when the server stopped and are marked as failed
template.comment: New scenario: change browser.baseUrl and steps into the real actions, save a new revision, then validate it. See docs/design/dsl.html
js.save_failed: That did not work; try again
js.publish_body: After publishing, runs use this revision; earlier published revisions stay in the history. Publish it?
js.cancel_body: The browser stops right away. Actions already completed on the target site are not undone.
js.stale_base: Someone saved a newer revision; reload and edit again
js.json_invalid: The inputs must be a JSON object (names and values inside curly braces)
